company.name: Helios
company.shortDescription: Helios offers bicycle handlebars that integrate high-power LEDs, Bluetooth 4.0, and GPS tracking capabilities.
company.description:
Helios is bike enthusiasts & dedicated riders. They understand the risks of sharing a road with automobiles, and believe that bikes should be just as visible as any other vehicle on the road.

They are also inventors & entrepreneurs. They realize that the biking experience can be greatly improved in many different facets. By infusing bicycles with smart technology, they hope to revolutionize the way bikers interact with their bikes.
